Tomato___Late_blight.preventive_organic: Spray Trichoderma viride @ 5g/L or 5% Neem Seed Kernel Extract (NSKE).
Tomato___Late_blight.irrigation_advice: Stop overhead sprinkler irrigation immediately. Water strictly at root zone.

Tomato___Early_blight.preventive_organic: Prune lower infected leaves; apply Pseudomonas fluorescens @ 10g/L.
Tomato___Early_blight.irrigation_advice: Improve spacing for ventilation to reduce leaf wetness duration.

Potato___Late_blight.preventive_organic: Spray copper oxychloride (COC) @ 2.5g/L before continuous rain spells.
Potato___Late_blight.irrigation_advice: Ensure deep ridge drainage to prevent waterlogging around tubers.

Rice___Bacterial_leaf_blight.preventive_organic: Spray fresh cow dung slurry extract (20%) or neem cake aqueous extract.
Rice___Bacterial_leaf_blight.irrigation_advice: Drain excess standing water from paddy fields for 3–4 days.

Rice___Brown_spot.preventive_organic: Seed treatment with Trichoderma harzianum @ 10g/kg seed.
Rice___Brown_spot.irrigation_advice: Maintain uniform shallow water depth; correct nitrogen-potash soil balance.
